rule.title: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise

summary.allegation: The cardholder says the Carlton armchair delivered has a structural fault, the frame wobbles and one leg is not properly seated, that it is not fit for purpose, and that the merchant did not respond to their refund request.
summary.to_defend: Visa 13.3 requires the published description of the item purchased, evidence that what was delivered matched that description, and evidence that a return or refund route was offered and not used or that the cardholder kept using the item after complaining.

requirements.title: Published item description
requirements.text: The merchant's published description of the item the cardholder purchased.
requirements.finding: The listing snapshot, generated from the product page on the transaction date, gives the full published description of the Carlton Mid-Century Armchair in sage velvet at £329.00, matching the disputed amount.

citations.quote:
The Carlton armchair combines a hand-finished beech frame with deep-buttoned
sage velvet upholstery. Tapered solid oak legs. Seat height 46cm.
Listing snapshot generated from the product page as of 15 April 2025.

requirements.title: Delivered item matches description
requirements.text: Evidence the item delivered matches that description (photos, specs, serial number match).
requirements.finding: The delivery photo shows a sage armchair with dark legs delivered on 18 Apr 2025, which is consistent with the listed colour and style, but it is a front view only with no SKU or serial reference, no view of the legs, underside or frame, and so it cannot show the item was free of the alleged structural fault.
requirements.gap: No pre-dispatch or delivery imagery of the legs, underside and frame joint, no SKU or serial match, and no QA or inspection record tying a specific unit to this order.

citations.quote: Photo taken by driver at delivery (front view only)

requirements.title: Return route offered and unused
requirements.text: Evidence the merchant offered a return/refund route and the cardholder did not use it, OR evidence the cardholder used and retained the merchandise after raising the complaint.
requirements.finding: Only a generic returns policy page is supplied; there is no record that the merchant offered this cardholder a collection, repair, replacement or refund for this order, no correspondence log, and no evidence the cardholder continued to use and retain the armchair after complaining.
requirements.gap: Missing the returns@havenhome.example correspondence for this order, any collection or repair offer sent to the cardholder, and any evidence of continued use or retention after the complaint.

documents.label: Generic returns policy page
documents.reason: Undated template policy last updated January 2025; it contains no record of this cardholder contacting the merchant or of any refund or collection offer for this order.

alerts.text: The cardholder states the merchant did not respond to a refund request; the file contains no email or ticket record from returns@havenhome.example for this order, so the analyst should confirm whether any response exists before filing.
Evidence for R2 was read from an image. Check the highlight.

justification: R3 is unmet and R2 only partial; both gaps are the kind the merchant can close with correspondence and condition records, so hold representment pending those documents.
rationale:
Cardholder alleges the £329.00 Carlton armchair delivered on 18 April 2025 has a wobbling frame and a badly seated leg and that no refund response was given.
The published listing for SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG at £329.00 matches the disputed transaction txn_6634KL of 15 April 2025, so the description requirement is met.
The only condition evidence is a front-view driver photo with no SKU, serial or view of the legs or frame, so it cannot rebut the structural fault claim.
No correspondence, collection offer or continued-use evidence has been supplied, leaving the return or refund route requirement unmet.
Request the missing records before representing; on the current file the case would likely fail.
merchant_requests: Full email or ticket thread from returns@havenhome.example for this order between 18 April and 8 May 2025, including any response to the cardholder's refund request.
Any written offer of free collection, repair, replacement or refund sent to the cardholder for order SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG, with the date sent.
Pre-dispatch QA or warehouse photographs of the specific unit shipped, showing the legs, underside and frame joint, with the unit or serial identifier linked to this order.
Proof of delivery document with signature or recipient name and delivery address for the 18 April 2025 delivery to postcode BS8 1TR.
Any evidence the cardholder retained or continued to use the armchair after raising the complaint, for example a declined collection slot or a failed collection record.
